description_en: Describes the syntax and examples for the RecognizeBusinessLicense operation in the OCR category
description_zh: 本文介绍文字识别（ocr）类目下的营业执照识别RecognizeBusinessLicense的语法及示例
name: RecognizeBusinessLicense

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in regions other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

Data.description_en: The data of the returned result

Address.description_en: The company address. If the recognition fails, `FailInRecognition` is returned
Address.description_zh: 公司地址。识别失败时返回`FailInRecognition`
Address.example: 浙江省杭州市西湖区转塘科技经济区块888号888幢

Angle.description_en: The angle of the input image (clockwise rotation). Valid values: 0, 90, 180, and 270
Angle.description_zh: 输入图片的角度（顺时针旋转）。枚举值包括：0、90、180、270

Business.description_en: The business scope. If the recognition fails, `FailInRecognition` is returned

Business.example: 网络技术服务；网站建设；销售：I类医疗器械、保健用品（不含保健食品）等

ValidPeriod.description_en:
The end date of the business term of the company. For example, if the certificate shows "April 16, 2014 to April 15, 2034", the API operation returns "20340415".

The current algorithm unifies the date format output as "YYYYMMDD" (for example, "20391130") and uses "29991231" to indicate "long-term"
ValidPeriod.description_zh:
公司营业期限终止日期。例如证件上为“2014年04月16日至2034年04月15日”，则接口返回“20340415”。

当前算法将日期格式统一输出为“年月日”（例如“20391130”），并用“29991231”表示“长期”
